subject: GalaxyBank CAIQ: annotated CCM trace and evidence index
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@galaxybank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: GalaxyBank CAIQ: annotated CCM trace and evidence index

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for walking through the CAIQ scope earlier. Attached is a first-pass annotated mapping (GalaxyBank_CCM_annotated_mapping.xlsx) that cross-references the CSA CCM controls with the CAIQ questions you provided, plus a compact evidence index (CAIQ_evidence_index_v1.pdf) that lists where each artifact lives and the proposed control owner at Redwood.

High level:
- We split controls into three buckets: config/evidence ready, evidence needs scrubbing (PII or contract redactions), and evidence to be generated (short retention logs, one-off exports).
- L7 logical separation items are marked with an asterisk — those are where we rely on VPC tenancy + subnet-level ACLs.

Ask: can you confirm the GalaxyBank owners you want us to align to for the L7 items (Network/Security architecture review vs App platform team)? If you can confirm by EOD Fri Nov 3 we’ll prioritize the scrubbing and produce the redacted artifacts.

Also included: a Drive link in the spreadsheet to each artifact for quicker handoff (internal link). If your vendor risk portal needs a different format, tell us and we’ll export.

Attachments: GalaxyBank_CCM_annotated_mapping.xlsx; CAIQ_evidence_index_v1.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min sync if helpful.

— Marcus Lin
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@galaxybank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: sec-portal@galaxybank.com
Date: 2026-10-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GalaxyBank CAIQ: annotated CCM trace and evidence index

Marcus —

Appreciate the fast turn. A couple of clarifications as we ingest this:

1) For the L7 flag: Galaxy's network team will own the architecture attestations; our vendor-risk team (sec-portal@galaxybank.com) will own the final control sign-off. Please mark the spreadsheet accordingly.

2) For items you classify as "evidence needs scrubbing": we need redacted copies of customer contracts and a copy of the TLS termination config (server certs + issuer details are sufficient; private keys obviously not).

3) The vendor portal requires a small sample of transport logs for a retention/audit test (last 7 days). Can you provide a sanitized sample (remove internal IPs or replace with placeholders)? Ideally .txt or .zip.

4) Also confirm whether any CAIQ entries reference third-party sub-processors (we need names and MSA versions).

We’ll queue this in our portal once we have those artifacts. If you can drop the sanitized logs and updated mapping by Tue Nov 2 we’ll aim to complete our initial review by Nov 6.

Thanks,
Elaine
Information Security Manager
Galaxy Bank

Elaine —

Thanks — we can do that. Quick answers inline and what we’re attaching now:

- L7 owners: updated the mapping sheet to show "Network Architecture (Galaxy) / Platform (Redwood)" in the owner column for the flagged rows.
- Redactions: we will produce two contract PDFs: one redacted for public submission and a full copy under NDA if you need it.
- Transport logs: attached a sanitized sample (network-logs-sample.txt). We replaced internal IPs with <INT_IP_x> placeholders and stripped session IDs.
- Sub-processors: the mapping includes a sub-processor column; current list: FastStore Inc. (S3-like storage), GPUCloud LLC (inference infra), SysMetrics (telemetry). We attached the CSDs where available in the Drive links.

Action items we completed with this email:
- Attached: network-logs-sample.txt (sanitized)
- Updated: GalaxyBank_CCM_annotated_mapping.xlsx (owner column + redaction notes)
- Note: CAIQ evidence index has a column "format_for_portal" — set to "yes" for items we can upload directly.

If you prefer, we can set a 30-min call: Tue Nov 2 between 10:00-12:00 PT works for Kimberly and me.

— Marcus

Attachments: network-logs-sample.txt

Thanks — quick internal & external status update.

Internal next steps (Redwood owners):
- Marcus: finalize redacted contracts and upload both redacted + full-binder (NDA-only) to Drive by Nov 2 EOD.
- Sofia: collect platform config screenshots for L7 controls and attach to the mapping (marked in the spreadsheet).
- I will own the portal uploads and the metadata fields (format_for_portal) once artifacts are verified.

External ask to Galaxy: can you confirm the portal date for evidence ingestion (we need the target ingest window so we can time exports)? If Nov 6 is still your target, we’ll prioritize the uploads on Nov 3-4.

Also note: I added a short README tab in the spreadsheet that explains the evidence classification (ready / redact / generate) and the expected artifact filename format for your intake team.

Kimberly Park

Redwood Inference
